name: Console
title: Templates/Shells/Console
summary: The application shell every signed-in page renders inside: a full-height navigation rail on the left that the user resizes by its edge and collapses from its foot (the product wordmark, the ⌘K palette with its Recents, navigation, Actions and Account groups, the navigation Menu with its grouped sections and drill-in levels, and the account menu with the theme switch, the Upgrade to Pro action and the system status at its foot) and a content zone on the right whose global header carries the breadcrumb from the second level on, the search affordance, the Create button, the Agent button and the account avatar. The search is a 32px field-shaped button while the bar’s content box is at least `--container-2xl` (752px) wide and an outlined IconButton below it; below `md` the rail becomes a Drawer opened from the hamburger that leads the wordmark. First-level lists, detail pages with their tabs and Home all render inside it. Built from `PageHeader`, `PageTabs`, `Sidebar`, `Menu`, `Command`, `DropdownMenu`, `ThemeSwitcher`, `StatusIndicator`, `Avatar`, `GlobalHeader`, `Breadcrumb`, `Button`, `ButtonHighlight`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `Kbd`, `Drawer` and, per page, `Tabs`, `Select`, `Tag`, `Input` and `Card`; the page bodies here are stand-ins, the real ones are the TableView and DetailsPage templates.

variants.name: DetailPage
variants.summary: A resource detail page: the breadcrumb reads Resources, the resource, then its environment, whose last crumb is a Select that searches the resource’s environments, tags each with its deployment policy and offers Add Environment at its foot; a full-bleed Tabs bar under the header carries the Overview, Deployments and Settings tabs with the outlined Deploy action, and the content scrolls beneath it.
